hypothesis: Measured external reference spectra may recover candidate coverage/rank1 that additional tail training did not improve
declared_dataset_license: CC0-1.0; merged GNPS/MassBank/MoNA upstream record provenance is not present in the served metadata and remains a limitation
source_B_massbank: Not adopted in this experiment; mixed record licenses require separate handling
implementation: Independent local implementation of public fixed-threshold spectral matching; official RDKit2026.03.3 identity deduplication added. This is not an exact reproduction of the full public notebook.
selection: No threshold or recipe search. Constants fixed from source before new80 confirmation metrics are read. Previously used30 development queries provide a rejection/diagnostic check only.
overlap_audit: Compute both public-like all-reference matches and an acquisition-input-excluded view that removes reference rows matching any query's rounded full-peak or FP16top96 signature, without query structure labels. Never select between them on confirmation.
production_candidate: P01 plus all-reference fixed-threshold promotions, with official metric identity deduplication; preserve original list on unavailable/protected/error paths
confirmation: If development does not reject the approach, report full80 and predeclared raw-reference-clean cohort separately, P14/P15 negatives and uncertainty; no reserved coefficient selection
scientific_limitations: External-source panel and incomplete reference record attribution limit leakage and hidden-score conclusions. Report same-input matches separately from novel acquisition evidence.
